text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A at a gain felt good, but it did not protect the account from later declines; I should evaluate the portfolio, not celebrate isolated realized gains.","After buying all five stocks, I held through substantial losses without reassessing. I should make deliberate decisions based on risk and allocation, not avoid selling simply because a position is below my cost.","Random price moves and infrequent reviews make short-term trading unreliable. I should follow a consistent review plan and avoid treating recent declines as predictions of what comes next."]}
